items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t care if it’s Aristotle walking around with 14 other philosophers. He was cool.

ctx.x: But 50 years ago, you had hundreds of tenor players who sounded like Lester Young, or hundreds of alto players who sounded like Bird.

I don’t know about that. I’m not sure if hundreds is the word. I think less than we have now. That’s my point. Now it’s just a – the number thing is exponential. There weren’t hundreds then. If there were hundreds then, there are thousands now, because it’s definitely more now. Take any given night in New York City and walk around to the classes – to classrooms that guys are playing – we did not have that 30, 40 years ago, because we didn’t have the thing. We didn’t have the forum for it. The fact that everybody…
I think the overall level of technical accomplishment is probably as good as it’s ever been.
